title: CorpusPrep: corpus preparation for linguists
description:
CorpusPrep prepares source texts for corpus analysis: the stage before AntConc or WordSmith Tools, both of which assume a clean corpus. Almost no researcher has one.

Every line of a document is labelled before anything is removed, so the researcher decides what constitutes the corpus, and an accompanying log records how that decision was made. Detection never deletes, and every rule reports the evidence it acted on.

Handles Project Gutenberg apparatus, mass-digitisation boilerplate, front and back matter, chapter and act segmentation, page furniture in scanned text, footnotes, hyphenation broken across line breaks, and paragraph reflow of hard-wrapped sources. Imports TXT, DOCX, EPUB and HTML.

Runs as a Python package or as a single-file web application requiring no installation and no upload: the text never leaves the machine it is opened on.

Error rates are measured against hand-marked answer keys and reported rather than asserted, and the two implementations are checked against each other on every commit.
